g.text: Palladio began it outside Vicenza in 1567. 1 — the hall is a `room circle`: its faces never go
faceted and its area is exact πR². 2 — everything below the `component` line is written once and
placed four times: unturned, 90, 180, 270. 3 — a column is a round wall stub, because only
walls, rooms and openings survive a quarter turn exactly. 4 — the four subtotals agree because
the geometry does, not because anyone typed them. 25 rooms, 819.03 m².
